fusions.name: Exhaust Vent
fusions.desc: Vents engine exhaust around you, which deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Burning] for 4 seconds. The thrust moves you 12% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Incendiary Canister
fusions.desc: Lobs a pressurised canister that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Afterburner
fusions.desc: A burner kicks you 3 tiles from where you stood, then your movement speed rises by 35% and your dodge chance by 8% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Kept at Forge Heat
fusions.desc: Conjures a tool held at forge heat by its own burner. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
